source: Previously completed 75% it50/25% Sapling V3 vs original Master3s2 development games on both seats, next observations and actions frozen. No official exam seeds.
selection: One substitution for one worker per map, seat and family. Legal pure worker moves with no joint friendly destination collision and no enemy base. Capture: own planter on active enemy tree with sufficient starting treasury and moving away; stay. Approach: own planter one orthogonal step away from a live enemy tree at age <=35; move onto it. Defend: own collector can enter an own tree at age <=35 with an opposing planter on or adjacent to the tree, whose recorded root action is not consulted. For capture and approach, discard root proposals exposing the destination to any other public opponent worker in one step. For defense discard enemy collectors which are not heavier than the focal collector and can reach its destination; target opposing planter is allowed. Order within family/map/seat by SHA256 of fixed textual seed+map+seat+t+unit+tree; do not inspect outcomes. Put no requirement on each alternative's sign.
continuation: At root opponent uses original recorded command, our arm changes one worker. Beyond root our true frozen .75/.25 parent reads its own branch's public observations. The opponent's original action tape stays fixed; missing units are ignored by official rules. This is a conditional sensitivity study, not adaptive opponent search or a fresh win-rate exam. Compare with unchanged parent whose 299 actions and official terminal score must match. Record opponent-ID drift, positive and negative results and official score. No weight fitting or candidate selection from these exposed development maps.
